svg.title: Proposed simpler architecture — services, code modules, storage and messaging

g.text: Proposed simpler architecture — services, code modules, storage and messaging
Blue boxes = service deployments; the listed code modules are NOT separate processes.
Solid arrows = requests / SQL. Dashed orange arrows = asynchronous event flow.
Notification receives the required delivery contact in a restricted event payload.
Audit persists a redacted subset of events; no passenger document numbers in general event streams.
Private databases may share a PostgreSQL cluster in a lab; they do not share application tables.
Production replicas, backups and failure domains are not expanded in this logical view.
DevOps operates deployments, CI/CD, secrets, metrics, logs and tracing across all services.
Not included by default: separate Search service, OpenSearch, Redis, Kubernetes.
